scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:icons: mkdir -p resources && cp icon.png resources/icon.png && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#10100e' --splashBackgroundColor '#10100e'
scripts.android:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npm run mobile:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='' build
